articles.title: Healey vows to 'Back British' in future defence spending as allies question UK's commitment to stealth fighter and submarine projects
articles.summary: The UK Defence Secretary has committed to prioritizing British manufacturers for military equipment procurement. This pledge is a crucial part of Britain's urgent effort to regenerate its defence capabilities. The strategy aims to bolster the domestic industrial base while simultaneously enhancing the Armed Forces' readiness and national security, ensuring a self-reliant defence supply chain.

articles.title: India, Vietnam looking at joint production of military hardware
articles.summary: India and Vietnam stressed the importance of peace and freedom of navigation in the Indo-Pacific. They resolved to deepen defence cooperation, including the joint production of military hardware. This strategic partnership enhances regional stability and signifies India's growing engagement with key Southeast Asian nations, crucial for India's maritime security interests and geopolitical influence in the region.
